remaining_finding.control_gap: Synthetic receipt-finalization injection occurs before record_interruption_failure, so it does not cover injection during write_once.
remaining_finding.detail: The one pending-signal failure guard and launch receipt snapshot precede both receipt/observation writes. Record-only handlers remain active until after those writes. A signal during publication can be appended after the acceptance decision and omitted from written evidence.
remaining_finding.required: An explicit finite publication fence/commit boundary that prevents acceptance after observed precommit interruption, with a pure synthetic interruption during publication control.
